_comment: DEMO token->workspace mapping consumed by server/tenancy.py (JsonTenantStore). Production impl backs onto the orchestration platform's Postgres tenancy (Deployment/DeploymentTier). tenant_id === the namespaced JWT claim https://leafdesign.ai/tenant_id (derived from app_metadata.leaf.organization_id, else the Auth0 sub). tier is surface-only here (no entitlement enforcement in this lane).
